query:
UPDATE referrals
        SET rewarded    = true,
            rewarded_at = NOW(),
            updated_at  = NOW()
        WHERE id IN (
            SELECT id FROM referrals
            WHERE referrer_id = $1
              AND status      = 'qualified'
              AND rewarded    = false
            ORDER BY qualified_at ASC
            LIMIT 5
            FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
        )
